---
title: "Herbarium Spectroscopy with MicroNIR"
subtitle: "Theory and practice"
---

# Introduction

Welcome!😊

This course was designed to train staff and fellows in the use of the portable MicroNIR spectrometer, covering everything from the initial setup of the equipment to the analysis of spectral data.

Over three days of theoretical and practical activities, participants will explore the fundamentals of near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy and its application to plant identification.

In addition, the course seeks to identify practical challenges in the use of the equipment, contributing to the development of an application protocol within the [SpectraPop Project](../index.qmd).

# Course details

**Where:** INPA Herbarium (1st floor, IFN Room), Av. André Araújo, 2.936 - 69067-375 - Petrópolis, Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles %>% # Add default OpenStreetMap map tiles
  setView(lng = -59.98748286262644, lat = -3.0950992004397473, zoom = 17)
```

**Date:** April 2–4, 2025.\

**Target audience:** Staff and fellows involved in the herbarium workflow who are interested in using portable spectroscopy for scientific research.\

**Number of places:** 13 (previously selected participants).\

**Course load:** 18 h (a certificate of participation will be issued).\

**Format:** Hybrid, with virtual theoretical classes and in-person practical classes. Four *laptops* will be available for the practical classes, and the activities will be carried out in four groups.

**Material:** Slides, *scripts* and data obtained during the course will be made available directly to the students or via [GitHub](https://github.com/ccvasconcelos/spectrapop).

**Important notes:**

-   External participants must present a photo ID (e.g., national ID card) and inform staff at any INPA gate that they are [taking part in a training at the INPA Herbarium]{.underline}.

-   For the theoretical classes, participants may attend from home or use INPA's facilities. If the latter, please let us know in advance.

-   At the end of the course, each participant must fill in an evaluation form to assess the training and to give suggestions for improving the MicroNIR usage protocol, which will later be made available to the entire interested community.

# Schedule

## Overview

The workshop activities will take place over three consecutive days, from Wednesday to Friday.

Morning sessions will run from 9:00 am to 12:00 pm (Amazonas standard time).

Afternoon sessions will run from 2:00 pm to 5:00 pm (Amazonas standard time).

# Funding

This course is part of the Project “Popularization of the use of the Species Spectral Signature in the identification of trees in Sustainable Forest Management in the Amazon - SPECTRA POP”, funded by the Amazonas State Research Support Foundation (FAPEAM), Call No. 006/2024 - Mulher Faz Ciência (Process No. 01.02.016301.04984/2024-17), and supported by the INPA Herbarium through the MCTI/FINEP/FNDCT Public Call No. 02/2016 – National Multi-User Centers.
